data: Jo (Rosalie Thomass) und Kati (Anna Maria Sturm) haben sich nach dem Abitur vor fünf Jahren aus den Augen verloren. Während Kati in der Nähe ihres Heimatdorfes zur Uni geht, hat sich Jo nach ausführlichen Reisen um den Globus in Indien niedergelassen. Diese Konstellation wird schlagartig auf den Kopf gestellt, als Kati eine Nachricht auf ihrem Anrufbeantworter als Hilferuf Jos interpretiert – und kurzerhand beschließt, nach Indien zu reisen. Doch Katis Versuche, die alte Clique aus Schulzeiten für den Trip in die Ferne zu gewinnen, schlagen fehl. Denn Rocky (Ferdinand Schmidt-Modrow) und Toni (Volker Bruch) sind mittlerweile fast verheiratet und haben ganz andere Dinge im Kopf als eine Indienreise. Also macht sich Kati alleine auf den Weg. Was sie aber nicht weiß: Jo ist in Wirklichkeit bereits auf der Rückreise nach Deutschland… (2020, City of Oviedo (Oviedo, Principality of Asturias, north to Spain). Juan Bravo is a filmmaker in his 60. After a carrier full of ups and downs specially after the flop of his last movie (a controversial and violent version of Jesuchrist), he lives in semi-retirement in the capital of Asturias trying to find a reason to keep alive, spending his days lost in his remembers of childhood and his dreams of youth. During a party made by his close friend producer Jacinto to celebrate the success of his last project, this one offers Juan a new chance to come back for directing a further movie for him despite the financial troubles and the production. The offer makes Juan question himself if accept it despite his enemies or retiring definitely. Through his experiences and his memories the capacity of humanity for hatred, Juan Bravo travels the city of Oviedo in search of himself and the same time that he analyzes his own life and the importance to be alive, looking for inspiration. Accompanied by Chopin's piece "Tristesse" throughout the film, Juan learns about the need of the artist to create and the inevitable fall on disgrace of the maturity, addressing about about disloyalty, hatred or decadence living in addition bizarre and surrealist situations on his daily life while he has a flirtation with death embodied in the character of a writer. A movie with a city than protagonist as the own Juan Bravo)
